quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
method: Per-epoch pixel count within site bbox exceeding -2.0 cm and -5.0 cm LOS thresholds multiplied by pixel area (0.0064 km^2 for 80 m grid) over common valid pixels; max_subsidence_cm uses 13x13 pixel (~1 km) block-median matching analysis/cumulative.py.
